verdict.rationale: The pack never documents a visual deal pipeline, customizable deal stages, or drag-and-drop updates. Deals appear only as importable records, as CRM data the MCP server can read and write, and in AI 'smart deal progression', a different feature that does not establish a visual board or configurable stages. Pipeline tracking is a core axis for a CRM, so the lack of evidence is 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As a founder, I can track deals on a visual pipeline with customizable stages and drag-and-drop updates
